in_marathi.name: Deeraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's light, radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deeraj is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘da’ (god) and ‘rāj’ (king, light). This name represents the divine light of God that illuminates the path of life.
